correctness.rationale: The proof reduces sampling to a frame of Taylor-subtracted kernel vectors. The asymptotic norm constant is finite and positive exactly when m+1/2<s<m+3/2; Bessel boundedness then forces bounded locations. Continuity excludes nonzero accumulation points, and the first nonzero Taylor coefficient makes the frame operator trace-class, contradicting the lower frame bound in infinite-dimensional L2([-a,a]).
